name: rosetta-synchronous-concurrency
code:
use IO.Std.write_line
use Ghul.Coroutines

union Request is
    PRINT(line: string)
    COUNT
si

use Request.COUNT
use Request.PRINT

let path = "input.txt"

IO.File.write_all_lines(path, ["Enjoy", "Rosetta", "Code"])

let requests = CHANNEL[Request]()
let replies = CHANNEL[int]()

printer() -> COROUTINE is
    let printed mut = 0

    do
        let request = await requests.receive()

        if isa PRINT(request) then
            write_line(request.line)
            printed = printed + 1
        else
            replies.send(printed)
            break
        fi
    od
si

reader() -> COROUTINE is
    for line in IO.File.read_lines(path) do
        requests.send(PRINT(line))
        await pause()
    od

    requests.send(COUNT)

    let printed = await replies.receive()

    write_line("{printed} lines printed")
si

printer()
reader()

run()

IO.File.delete(path)
